tools.name: sensorium_binning
tools.description: Bins a raw time-series microstate stream into discrete macrostate bins and calculates Walsh-Hadamard sequency profiles and TDA persistent homology.

tools.name: causal_discovery
tools.description: Runs PC and FCI algorithms on tabular datasets to recover Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAG) or Partial Ancestral Graphs (PAG) under linear or non-linear kernel mode.

variables.description: Names of variables in the dataset

data_dict.description: Mapping from variable names to numerical arrays

mode.description: Linear partial correlation vs Kernel non-linear (R-HSIC) independence tests

tools.name: epistemic_gp_update
tools.description: Tracks and predicts epistemic belief states using online Gaussian Process (GP) kernel regression on continuous streams.

tools.name: thermodynamic_audit
tools.description: Calculates path entropy, Landauer limits of heat dissipation, and computes feasibility index for workloads.

bits_erased.description: Number of bits erased during computation

tools.name: meta_learning_lora
tools.description: Applies INT8 quantization and creates low-rank adapter (LoRA) matrices representing weight deltas.

in_features.description: Number of input features for LoRA adapter

out_features.description: Number of output features for LoRA adapter

tools.name: robustness_regularization
tools.description: Simulates Wasserstein DRO bounds, Kolmogorov MDL regularization, or Reinforcement Learning-inspired dynamic risk parameter adjustment.

simulation_type.description: The type of robustness or regularization simulation to run.

rule_complexities.description: List of description lengths/complexities of candidate rules for Kolmogorov MDL.

data_likelihoods.description: List of likelihoods/probabilities of data given each rule.

reward_signals.description: Historical reward feedback signals for Reinforcement Learning policy updates.

learning_rate.description: Learning rate for Reinforcement Learning gradient updates.

tools.name: fetch_alpaca_market_quotes
tools.description: Fetches live or synthetic stock market quotes for a given symbol and limit to feed to the AGI sensorium.

symbol.description: Stock symbol to fetch quotes for.

limit.description: Number of quote records to retrieve.

tools.name: read_system_file
tools.description: Securely reads the contents of a local file within the workspace.

path.description: Absolute or relative path of the file to read.

tools.name: search_project_directory
tools.description: Lists files or searches for pattern matches inside the project workspace directory.

path.description: Relative subdirectory path to search within the project.

pattern.description: Filename glob pattern (e.g. *.py) to filter files.

tools.name: hchl_inference
tools.description: Runs inference using the Hypergeneralized Causal-Homological Latent (HCHL) Transformer model, checking causal d-separation, persistent homology, and robust optimization bounds.

system_prompt.description: The system prompt framing the reasoning.

domain.description: Optional domain overrides (causal, epistemic, thermo, code, json, general).

tools.name: run_compliance_audit
tools.description: Runs an automated standards compliance audit evaluating model history against ISO/IEC 42001 and NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF) 1.0.

query_logs.description: Optional list of past query logs to audit.
